traditional: No classical doctrine: Pluto is a modern planet unknown to traditional astrology. Read from the modern and cyclic layers; treat this contact as a slow, generational background tone.
modern: Emotion meets power and intensity. Feelings run deep and extreme, with strong swings. The sextile makes this a natural strength: Emotional depth and resilience that can be drawn on deliberately. The growth edge is not to coast on the ease.

cyclic.waxing: A chance to organize feeling and power into a new form; it must be actively taken up.
cyclic.waning: Reorganize and share what feeling and power have taught; communicate the insight.

business: An opening in this area. Emotional intensity: depth is an asset, volatility a liability.
shadow: The ease lets moodiness and over-need and control and obsession go unchecked, or the opening pass unused.
arcApplying: A supportive opening becomes available; offered, not automatic.
arcSeparating: The opening closes; unused, it passes.

readerCopy.body: A reaction that looks wildly disproportionate to the moment usually snaps into focus the second you trace it back to its root. When the Moon sextiles Pluto, emotional honesty cuts through the fog, allowing you to see the older fear, resentment, or attachment giving a minor friction point so much weight. You don't need to turn every revelation into an excavation project. Spot the underlying pattern so you can stop treating the surface irritation like it's the entire crisis.
